scope: Independent read-only review of this worktree creation/adoption slice; source and existing author-run outputs. No tests, Git repository mutation, process control, real Agent or installed App operation by this reviewer.
sourceCheckpoint: Final owner freeze after 28 worktrees tests and 3 actual exit/reset gate tests; does not certify whole-project integration or native acceptance.

findings.origin: Independent reviewer identified post-preflight source add as still outside private object context; architecture implemented and ran the counterexample.
findings.failure: After private preparation, missing commit plus newly configured promisor caused source worktree add --no-checkout to execute the owned local remote-helper canary.
findings.fix: Every owned Git command sets the fixed official GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1; missing objects fail locally. Actual Apple Git 2.39.5 probe and unchanged canary assertion are green. No Agent environment/config change.

findings.origin: Architecture identified and tested; independently read by verification.
findings.failure: A linked source used per-worktree info/attributes instead of Git resolved common attributes, losing CRLF conversion.
findings.fix: Git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path info/attributes chooses the actual attribute path; captured bytes and effective attribute mirror remain bounded. The same test now also reaches the effective-filter rejection check.

findings.origin: Independent reviewer identified, product_coverage wrote actual DTO/parser/SSR red and fix.
findings.failure: unknown plus code cancelled after possible material creation displayed a claim that creation had not started.
findings.fix: Only confirmed state cancelled uses no-start language; all other cancelled-code states display a cancellation-request message. Unknown, target path, acknowledgement and admission remain unchanged.

findings.origin: Independent reviewer checked official check-attr ambiguity; architecture ran actual Git transformation and production preflight red.
findings.failure: The literal filter driver named unset was confused with disabled filter and silently accepted despite an actual configured transformation.
findings.redBoundary: The loop failed on unset; unspecified was not reached in red and previously rejected later by mirror mismatch.
findings.fix: An ambiguous unset with configured nonempty smudge/process or required=true rejects as filters. Explicit unspecified is rejected as a driver value. No helper is run by Farfold to resolve the ambiguity.

reviewedInvariants: Exact selected OID is checked in a private Git config/ref/index context. Worktree registration uses no-checkout; before and after materialization the target/root/common/git identity, branch and OID are checked; new index publication is no-clobber.

Git arguments are structured, shell-free. Current owned subprocess group and direct child retain admission through completion/reap; output uses bounded anonymous files. Surviving helpers are not a successful receipt. This does not prove control of escaped external processes.

The current operation intent is saved before Git dispatch. Final save failure retains unknown and existing materials. Recovery compares old/intended raw values and retries metadata only, never restarts Git.
Same ID/different current payload rejects; persisted location and retained material IDs are retired on cold load. Existing/adopted ownership cannot become created by matching a path.
Unknown material acknowledgement stores the possible path and reviewed status, preserves unknown, and never grants ready/created/deletion rights. A later explicit adoption records existing ownership.
Quit, data reset and managed update use real backend gates. A worker owned by this process cannot be confirmed away; successful gates retain admission through the corresponding operation.
Official bool normalization preserves accepted aliases; sparseCheckout=false does not imply an active sparse checkout profile.

evidenceRead.formatAndClippy: owned-format-final and clippy-boundaries-final exited successfully; reviewer did not rerun them.

boundaries: Cold unknown plus settled means this instance owns no current worker; it is not proof that a child from an earlier crashed process ended. Review note explicitly says acknowledgement proves neither creation success nor prior operation stop. No persisted process ledger was added.
The rare combination of disabled -filter and an independently configured driver literally named unset is conservatively refused because Git check-attr output cannot distinguish it from filter=unset.
No claim of a filesystem sandbox against arbitrary same-UID writers or escaped processes. Repeated identity checks do not provide atomic protection from every external race.

Tests are controlled temporary repositories on this macOS Git. No Windows Git implementation/native verification, installed worktree journey, real project mutation, or full H15 archive/delete acceptance is claimed.
This receipt is a source checkpoint. Final integrated source hashes and required whole-project checks remain root responsibilities.
